Pickaxe Mountain Nuclear Site Remains Unstruck
He singled out one location. "You probably could look at Pickaxe Mountain, and you have to take care of that," Trump said.
Western intelligence has flagged Pickaxe Mountain as a site likely used to store nuclear material. The U.S. has not struck it during the war.
